description: Read a multi-branch calculateIncomeTax(double income) method to identify every branch, boundary value, and invalid input that a test suite should cover.
source: draft: agy free model + edit: codex

steps.description: In calculateIncomeTax(double income), precompute cumulative tax amounts base10 through base35 for the six lower tax brackets.
Use a seven-branch if / else if / else ladder on lines 12-26 to select the bracket for income and return result.

steps.answer: For 25000, income < 9950 is false and income < 40525 is true. Line 15 computes base10 + (25000 - 9950) * 0.12 = 2801.0. For negative income, income < 9950 is true, so line 13 returns a negative tax.
steps.question: Which branch runs when main calls calculateIncomeTax(25000), and what happens if a negative income is passed?

steps.description: Call calculateIncomeTax(25000) in main and print the resulting tax owed.
Watch income = 25000 enter the second branch (income < 40525) on line 15 and compute result = 2801.0.

title: Designing Branch and Boundary Tests for Tax Brackets
